title: MIHVER Publication Grant (broker-owned state)
description: Machine-readable shape of a server-side PublicationGrant record (tools/publication-broker/internal/grant.Grant is the canonical Go implementation). Never authored by Claude or any Codex role -- created only through the privileged admin Unix socket (internal/grant.AdminHandle.Create), by a human, in response to a REQUEST DIGEST mihver-publish printed. See docs/development/PUBLICATION_BROKER.md's 'Server-Side PublicationGrant' section, which is the semantic owner of the grant lifecycle this schema only describes the shape of.

request_digest.description: The exact REQUEST DIGEST this grant authorizes -- a grant is bound to at most one digest, ever.

blocked_reason.description: Present only once state is BLOCKED.

remote_head_observed.description: Set once a push under this grant succeeds -- what makes an identical retry after a partial failure idempotent rather than re-pushing.

pr_number.description: Present only once a PR has been created or reused under this grant.
